roots.descriptionZh: 从运动、光与热的经典研究，进入场论、相对论和量子理论，再沿多体、粒子、宇宙与数学结构展开。这里的顺序概括分支形成脉络；时期不是所属每个概念的发现日期。交叉领域可多处收录，实验、工程方法和历史假说按其研究语境列入。 同时代并行发展的分支相邻展示，并不表示后一分支由前一分支单独派生。
roots.descriptionEn: From classical studies of motion, light and heat to fields, relativity and quantum theory, followed by many-body, particle, cosmological and mathematical developments. Ordering sketches the formation of subfields, not the discovery date of every concept. Cross-disciplinary concepts may appear more than once; experimental techniques, applications and historical hypotheses are placed in their research contexts. Contemporary developments are shown adjacently; this does not assert that one branch descends solely from its predecessor.

children.descriptionZh: 由运动和受力的描述发展出天体动力学、分析力学、连续介质及非线性动力学。
children.descriptionEn: Motion and forces develop into celestial dynamics, analytical mechanics, continuum theories and nonlinear dynamics.
children.periodZh: 古代前史；17—19世纪奠基，20世纪继续发展
children.periodEn: Ancient antecedents; foundations in the 17th–19th centuries, with later developments

children.descriptionZh: 物理量、量纲、计量单位与基本测量方法。
children.descriptionEn: Physical quantities, dimensional conventions, units and basic measurement methods.

children.descriptionZh: 位置、速度、转动以及惯性与非惯性参考系。
children.descriptionEn: Position, velocity, rotation, and inertial or accelerated reference frames.

children.zh: 牛顿动力学与守恒定律
children.descriptionZh: 力、动量、能量、碰撞和刚体的运动定律。
children.descriptionEn: Forces, momentum, energy, collisions and laws of rigid-body motion.
children.periodZh: 17世纪定律的综合；1687年《原理》是重要节点
children.periodEn: Seventeenth-century synthesis; the Principia (1687) is a major landmark

sources.title: Cambridge University Library: Newton, Gravity and glory
nLab: Symplectic geometry and its applications to physics

children.descriptionZh: 万有引力下的二体、多体、轨道与轨道稳定性问题。
children.descriptionEn: Two-body and many-body gravitational motion, orbits and orbital stability.

children.descriptionZh: 谐振、阻尼、模式、声波和介质中的波传播。
children.descriptionEn: Resonance, damping, normal modes, acoustics and wave propagation in media.

children.zh: 拉格朗日、哈密顿与几何力学
children.descriptionZh: 以作用量、约束、相空间与辛结构重述经典动力学。
children.descriptionEn: Classical dynamics in terms of actions, constraints, phase spaces and symplectic structures.

children.zh: 弹性、塑性与固体连续介质
children.descriptionZh: 应力应变、材料本构、梁板与损伤模型。
children.descriptionEn: Stress and strain, constitutive behaviour, beams, plates and damage models.

children.descriptionZh: 流场、黏性、湍流、自由表面及地球物理流动。
children.descriptionEn: Flow fields, viscosity, turbulence, free surfaces and geophysical flows.

children.descriptionZh: 无量纲数与传热、流动、反应的尺度比较。
children.descriptionEn: Dimensionless numbers and scale comparisons in flow, heat transport and reactions.

children.descriptionZh: 已有词库中的动力机械、流体装置与实验诊断方法。
children.descriptionEn: Mechanical and fluid devices and experimental diagnostics represented in the catalog.

children.zh: 非线性、混沌与可积动力学
children.descriptionZh: 稳定性、分岔、混沌、孤子与可积系统。
children.descriptionEn: Stability, bifurcations, chaos, solitons and integrable systems.

sources.title: Cambridge University Library: Newton, Gravity and glory
nLab: Symplectic geometry and its applications to physics

children.descriptionZh: 从光线和成像进入波动、相干与量子光学，保留几何与电磁两条联系。
children.descriptionEn: From rays and imaging to waves, coherence and quantum optics, linked to both geometry and electromagnetism.
children.periodZh: 古代光学前史；17—19世纪波动理论，20世纪光子学
children.periodEn: Ancient antecedents; wave theories in the 17th–19th centuries, photonics in the 20th

children.descriptionZh: 光线、透镜、孔径、像差和成像系统的几何描述。
children.descriptionEn: Geometrical descriptions of rays, lenses, apertures and imaging systems.

children.descriptionZh: 干涉、衍射、偏振、色散以及光与介质的相互作用。
children.descriptionEn: Interference, diffraction, polarization, dispersion and optical interactions with media.

children.descriptionZh: 激光、光模式、非线性响应、光子材料和光学通信。
children.descriptionEn: Lasers, optical modes, nonlinear responses, photonic materials and communication.

children.zh: 量子光学与光物质作用
children.descriptionZh: 光子的量子态、原子光学、光学测量和冷原子方法。
children.descriptionEn: Photon states, atom optics, optical measurements and cold-atom techniques.

sources.title: Smithsonian Libraries: Maxwell, A dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field (1865)
Niels Bohr Institute: The Copenhagen Interpretation and the development of quantum mechanics

children.descriptionZh: 从热机与热力学定律走向分子运动、统计系综、相变和非平衡过程。
children.descriptionEn: From heat engines and thermodynamic laws to molecular kinetics, ensembles, phase transitions and nonequilibrium processes.
children.periodZh: 19世纪热力学与动理论；19世纪末以后统计与临界理论
children.periodEn: Thermodynamics and kinetic theory in the 19th century; statistical and critical theories from the late 19th century

children.descriptionZh: 热、温度、平衡、可逆性与热力学基本关系。
children.descriptionEn: Heat, temperature, equilibrium, reversibility and fundamental thermodynamic relations.
children.periodZh: 19世纪热机研究与热力学定律的形成
children.periodEn: Nineteenth-century heat-engine research and the formation of thermodynamic laws

sources.title: American Physical Society: Carnot publishes his treatise on heat engines (1824)

children.descriptionZh: 内能、自由能、化学势、混合物与相平衡的状态函数。
children.descriptionEn: Internal and free energies, chemical potentials, mixtures and equilibrium state functions.

children.descriptionZh: 分子运动、碰撞、扩散、动理学方程与输运系数。
children.descriptionEn: Molecular motion, collisions, diffusion, kinetic equations and transport coefficients.

children.descriptionZh: 微观态、配分函数、统计分布和量子多粒子的平衡描述。
children.descriptionEn: Microstates, partition functions, distributions and equilibrium quantum statistics.

children.zh: 相变、临界现象与格点模型
children.en: Phase transitions, critical phenomena and lattice models
children.descriptionZh: 凝聚、熔化、临界标度、序参量及统计格点模型。
children.descriptionEn: Condensation, melting, critical scaling, order and statistical lattice models.

children.descriptionZh: 随机运动、涨落关系、耗散和反应驱动的自组织。
children.descriptionEn: Stochastic motion, fluctuation relations, dissipation and reaction-driven self-organization.

children.en: Heat transfer, engines and thermal measurement
children.descriptionZh: 传导、对流、辐射、制冷、燃烧与热工装置。
children.descriptionEn: Conduction, convection, radiation, cooling, combustion and thermal devices.

sources.title: American Physical Society: Carnot publishes his treatise on heat engines (1824)

children.descriptionZh: 静电与磁学研究在19世纪汇入统一场方程，再延伸到辐射、介质和等离子体。
children.descriptionEn: Electrostatics and magnetism converge in nineteenth-century field equations and extend to radiation, media and plasmas.
children.periodZh: 18—19世纪实验定律与场的统一；随后扩展
children.periodEn: Experimental laws and field unification in the 18th–19th centuries, followed by extensions

children.descriptionZh: 电荷、电势、多极展开和介电响应。
children.descriptionEn: Charge, electric potential, multipoles and dielectric response.

children.descriptionZh: 磁场、磁矩、磁通、磁性与磁场作用。
children.descriptionEn: Magnetic fields, moments, flux, magnetic response and magnetic forces.

children.descriptionZh: 电流、电动势、电感、磁路与电磁装置。
children.descriptionEn: Electric currents, electromotive forces, inductance, magnetic circuits and devices.

children.zh: 麦克斯韦理论、相对论与辐射
children.descriptionZh: 统一场方程、势、能动张量、电磁波与辐射。
children.descriptionEn: Unified field equations, potentials, stress–energy, electromagnetic waves and radiation.
children.periodZh: 19世纪场的统一；麦克斯韦1865年论文是重要节点
children.periodEn: Nineteenth-century field unification, including Maxwell’s 1865 paper

sources.title: Smithsonian Libraries: Maxwell, A dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field (1865)

children.descriptionZh: 带电介质、等离子体运动和天体磁流体过程。
children.descriptionEn: Charged media, plasma motion and astrophysical magnetofluid processes.

sources.title: Smithsonian Libraries: Maxwell, A dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field (1865)

children.descriptionZh: 狭义相对论重组时空和电磁运动学，广义相对论把引力与几何联系起来。
children.descriptionEn: Special relativity reorganizes spacetime and electrodynamics; general relativity relates gravity to geometry.
children.periodZh: 1905年前后狭义理论；1915年前后广义理论与后续发展
children.periodEn: Special relativity around 1905; general relativity around 1915 and subsequent developments

children.zh: 狭义相对论与洛伦兹运动学
children.descriptionZh: 同时性、四维运动学、质能关系与狭义理论的检验。
children.descriptionEn: Simultaneity, four-dimensional kinematics, mass–energy relations and tests of special relativity.

children.zh: 时空几何与引力场方程
children.descriptionZh: 度规、曲率、因果结构与爱因斯坦方程的几何形式。
children.descriptionEn: Metrics, curvature, causal structure and the geometrical form of Einstein’s equations.

children.zh: 引力检验、波与相对论天体
children.en: Gravitational tests, waves and relativistic astrophysics
children.descriptionZh: 弱场近似、引力波、致密天体与天体相对论效应。
children.descriptionEn: Weak-field approximations, gravitational waves, compact objects and relativistic astrophysical effects.

children.descriptionZh: 黑洞解、因果边界、引力坍缩及黑洞热力学和信息问题。
children.descriptionEn: Black-hole solutions, causal boundaries, collapse, thermodynamics and information.

children.en: Extensions of gravity and unification proposals
children.descriptionZh: 对广义相对论的推广、替代理论及其概念问题；收录不表示已被证实。
children.descriptionEn: Extensions and alternatives to general relativity and their conceptual issues; inclusion does not imply experimental confirmation.

children.zh: 时空观念与跨学科辨析
children.descriptionZh: 区分物理时空与其他学科借用的时空语言。时间—空间压缩在本词库指社会理论概念，不是狭义或广义相对论的物理效应。
children.descriptionEn: Distinguishes physical spacetime from uses of spacetime language in other disciplines. Time–space compression in this catalog is a social-theory concept, not a physical effect of special or general relativity.

sources.title: Time–space compression: social-theory usage and references
Science Museum: The past, present and future of general relativity

children.descriptionZh: 从旧量子问题到1920年代的力学框架，并发展出原子、多体、开放系统与量子信息方法。
children.descriptionEn: From early quantum problems to the mechanics of the 1920s and later atomic, many-body, open-system and information methods.
children.periodZh: 20世纪初至今；1925—1926年形成重要力学表述
children.periodEn: Early 20th century onward; major mechanical formulations in 1925–1926

children.descriptionZh: 态与概率、测量、解释、局域性和基础检验。
children.descriptionEn: States and probability, measurement, interpretations, locality and foundational tests.

children.zh: 量子动力学与近似方法
children.descriptionZh: 波动方程、算符演化、路径积分、隧穿与半经典近似。
children.descriptionEn: Wave equations, operator evolution, path integrals, tunnelling and semiclassical approximations.
children.periodZh: 1920年代形成矩阵力学与波动力学，并延续发展
children.periodEn: Matrix and wave mechanics take shape in the 1920s, with continuing developments

sources.title: Niels Bohr Institute: The Copenhagen Interpretation and the development of quantum mechanics

children.descriptionZh: 原子能级、跃迁、角动量耦合和自旋结构。
children.descriptionEn: Atomic levels and transitions, angular-momentum coupling and spin structure.

children.descriptionZh: 散射振幅、截面、共振以及量子输运。
children.descriptionEn: Scattering amplitudes, cross sections, resonances and quantum transport.

children.zh: 开放系统、退相干与量子热力学
children.en: Open systems, decoherence and quantum thermodynamics
children.descriptionZh: 环境耦合、约化态、主方程、退相干与信息耗散。
children.descriptionEn: Environmental coupling, reduced states, master equations, decoherence and information dissipation.

children.descriptionZh: 纠缠资源、量子通信、算法、逻辑门和纠错。
children.descriptionEn: Entanglement resources, communication, algorithms, gates and error correction.

children.zh: 量子模拟、器件与实验平台
children.en: Quantum simulation, devices and experimental platforms
children.descriptionZh: 量子模拟、计算硬件、量子存储与具体实验平台。
children.descriptionEn: Quantum simulation, computing hardware, memories and experimental platforms.

sources.title: Niels Bohr Institute: The Copenhagen Interpretation and the development of quantum mechanics

children.descriptionZh: 相对论与量子理论结合产生量子场框架，核与粒子现象推动规范理论和标准模型的发展。
children.descriptionEn: Relativity and quantum theory combine in quantum fields; nuclear and particle phenomena drive gauge theories and the Standard Model.
children.periodZh: 20世纪起；规范统一与标准模型在20世纪中后期成形
children.periodEn: From the 20th century; gauge unification and the Standard Model develop in its middle and later decades

children.descriptionZh: 原子核、核反应、放射性与核过程。
children.descriptionEn: Nuclei, reactions, radioactivity and nuclear processes.

children.descriptionZh: 基本粒子、强子、反粒子、复合态与粒子量子数。
children.descriptionEn: Elementary particles, hadrons, antiparticles, composite states and quantum numbers.

children.zh: 量子场、量子化与传播子
children.descriptionZh: 场的自由与相互作用描述、量子化、传播子和算符展开。
children.descriptionEn: Free and interacting fields, quantization, propagators and operator expansions.

children.descriptionZh: 碰撞过程、产生和衰变、截面、探测与高能现象学。
children.descriptionEn: Collision processes, production and decay, cross sections, detection and high-energy phenomenology.

children.zh: 重整化、有效理论与临界标度
children.descriptionZh: 正则化、尺度流、有效理论及与统计临界现象的联系。
children.descriptionEn: Regularization, scale flows, effective theories and connections to statistical criticality.

children.zh: 规范理论、对称性与标准模型
children.en: Gauge theories, symmetry and the Standard Model
children.descriptionZh: 规范场、守恒流、对称性破缺、异常和标准模型相互作用。
children.descriptionEn: Gauge fields, conserved currents, symmetry breaking, anomalies and Standard Model interactions.
children.periodZh: 20世纪中后期规范理论与标准模型的发展
children.periodEn: Gauge theories and the Standard Model develop during the middle and later 20th century

sources.title: CERN: The Standard Model

children.zh: 超对称与超越标准模型
children.en: Supersymmetry and beyond the Standard Model
children.descriptionZh: 超对称、统一模型、新粒子和未获证实的推广。
children.descriptionEn: Supersymmetry, unification, new particles and unconfirmed extensions.

sources.title: CERN: The Standard Model

children.descriptionZh: 由晶体、磁性与固体电子理论发展到超导、强关联、软物质和拓扑量子态。
children.descriptionEn: From crystals, magnetism and electronic solids to superconductivity, correlations, soft matter and topological quantum states.
children.periodZh: 19世纪材料研究前史；20世纪量子多体理论及其后续
children.periodEn: Nineteenth-century material studies; quantum many-body theories in the 20th century and beyond

children.descriptionZh: 晶格、倒格、结构缺陷、声子与晶格热性质。
children.descriptionEn: Lattices, reciprocal space, structural defects, phonons and lattice thermal properties.

children.descriptionZh: 磁有序、自旋耦合、磁共振与自旋电子学。
children.descriptionEn: Magnetic ordering, spin coupling, resonance and spintronics.

children.zh: 能带、费米面与电子输运
children.en: Bands, Fermi surfaces and electronic transport
children.descriptionZh: 固体能带、费米液体、局域化、输运与半导体响应。
children.descriptionEn: Electronic bands, Fermi liquids, localization, transport and semiconductor response.

children.descriptionZh: 超导配对、磁通效应、超流和低温量子流体。
children.descriptionEn: Superconducting pairing, flux phenomena, superfluidity and low-temperature quantum fluids.

children.descriptionZh: 准粒子、有效相互作用、低维模型和强关联多体态。
children.descriptionEn: Quasiparticles, effective interactions, low-dimensional models and strongly correlated many-body states.

children.descriptionZh: 胶体、聚合物、液晶、界面与复杂材料的集体现象。
children.descriptionEn: Collective behaviour of colloids, polymers, liquid crystals, interfaces and complex materials.

children.descriptionZh: 有效介质、数值多体方法、响应函数与材料实验探测。
children.descriptionEn: Effective media, numerical many-body methods, response functions and material probes.

children.zh: 拓扑相与量子临界现象
children.descriptionZh: 量子霍尔效应、拓扑绝缘体、拓扑序及量子临界点。
children.descriptionEn: Quantum Hall effects, topological insulators, topological order and quantum critical points.
children.periodZh: 1970—1980年代以来拓扑思想进入量子物质研究
children.periodEn: Topological approaches to quantum matter develop from the 1970s–1980s

sources.title: American Physical Society: Topological phases

American Physical Society: Topological phases
Niels Bohr Institute: The Copenhagen Interpretation and the development of quantum mechanics

children.descriptionZh: 从宇宙整体的历史模型发展到相对论膨胀宇宙、热大爆炸、结构形成与暗成分。
children.descriptionEn: From historical models of the cosmos to relativistic expansion, the hot Big Bang, structure formation and dark components.
children.periodZh: 古代宇宙观前史；20世纪形成现代观测与物理宇宙学
children.periodEn: Ancient cosmological antecedents; modern observational and physical cosmology in the 20th century

children.zh: 宇宙观、原则与历史模型
children.descriptionZh: 宇宙整体概念、基本原则与历史或推测性模型，区分观测事实与假说。
children.descriptionEn: Global concepts, principles and historical or speculative models, distinguishing observations from hypotheses.

children.zh: 相对论宇宙模型与膨胀
children.descriptionZh: 宇宙尺度因子、几何、距离、膨胀史与整体命运。
children.descriptionEn: Scale factors, geometry, distances, expansion history and the fate of the universe.
children.periodZh: 20世纪初相对论宇宙模型与1920年代膨胀观测
children.periodEn: Early twentieth-century relativistic models and expansion observations in the 1920s

sources.title: NASA LAMBDA: Graphic History to Cosmology

children.zh: 早期宇宙、背景辐射与物质起源
children.en: Early universe, background radiation and matter origins
children.descriptionZh: 热大爆炸、暴涨、粒子时期、核合成、复合与宇宙背景。
children.descriptionEn: The hot Big Bang, inflation, particle epochs, nucleosynthesis, recombination and cosmic backgrounds.
children.periodZh: 20世纪中期热大爆炸和宇宙背景研究，随后发展
children.periodEn: Mid-twentieth-century hot-Big-Bang and cosmic-background research, followed by later developments

sources.title: NASA LAMBDA: Graphic History to Cosmology

children.zh: 结构形成与观测宇宙学
children.descriptionZh: 密度扰动、星系与大尺度结构，以及观测距离和丰度的指标。
children.descriptionEn: Density perturbations, galaxies and large-scale structure, with observational distance and abundance indicators.

children.zh: 暗物质、暗能量与候选模型
children.en: Dark matter, dark energy and candidate models
children.descriptionZh: 暗成分的观测动机、现象学和粒子或引力候选模型。
children.descriptionEn: Observational motivations, phenomenology and particle or gravitational candidates for dark components.

sources.title: NASA LAMBDA: Graphic History to Cosmology

children.descriptionZh: 跨越上述物理分支的几何、分析、代数与计算结构，以及场论和量子引力研究路线。
children.descriptionEn: Geometrical, analytical, algebraic and computational structures spanning the preceding fields, together with field-theoretic and quantum-gravity research programmes.
children.periodZh: 与物理共同发展；19—21世纪的结构化与交叉研究
children.periodEn: Develops alongside physics; structural and interdisciplinary approaches in the 19th–21st centuries

children.descriptionZh: 物理方程的分析方法、谱理论、张量微积分和积分变换。
children.descriptionEn: Analytical methods for physical equations, spectral theory, tensor calculus and integral transforms.

children.zh: 辛几何、变分与几何量子化
children.en: Symplectic geometry, variation and geometric quantization
children.descriptionZh: 相空间、辛与 Poisson 结构、作用量及经典到量子理论的几何联系。
children.descriptionEn: Phase spaces, symplectic and Poisson structures, actions and geometrical links between classical and quantum theories.

children.descriptionZh: Lie 群、表示、旋量与算符代数在对称性和量子理论中的作用。
children.descriptionEn: Lie groups, representations, spinors and operator algebras in symmetry and quantum theory.

children.descriptionZh: 模拟、离散化、统计推断、随机矩阵和概率方法。
children.descriptionEn: Simulation, discretization, statistical inference, random matrices and probabilistic methods.

children.zh: 量子引力、全息与时空基础
children.en: Quantum gravity, holography and spacetime foundations
children.descriptionZh: 量子引力路线、全息、时空微观结构与量子宇宙学；区分模型与确证。
children.descriptionEn: Quantum-gravity programmes, holography, microscopic spacetime and quantum cosmology; models are distinguished from established results.

children.descriptionZh: 弦与膜模型、紧化、镜对称、各种对偶及超引力联系。
children.descriptionEn: String and brane models, compactification, mirror symmetry, dualities and supergravity.

children.en: Topological, conformal and algebraic field theories
children.descriptionZh: 拓扑不变量、范畴、共形与手征结构在场论和量子物质中的交汇。
children.descriptionEn: Intersections of topological invariants, categories, conformal and chiral structures with field theory and quantum matter.
